description: Baseline measurement of the current, unchanged game. The simulation framework does not invoke the shipped default AI (src/game/ai/ai.ts) directly — it is a separate, simpler heuristic tuned for real-time play. 'opportunist' at 'competent' skill (every score component at its unweighted default, full-search best-action selection) is used as the closest unbiased stand-in: a generalist, non-specialized rational player. This experiment intentionally has no seat swap: opportunist-vs-opportunist is a content mirror (both sides run the identical persona/skill), and every match already includes both factions (Carthage as p1, Rome as p2), so faction-level comparison (victoryRateByFaction) is available without swapping seats.
